articles.title: Google Fined €403 Million for GDPR Violations Over Users’ Location Data
articles.summary:

articles.title: Malicious npm Package With 2 Million Downloads Hides Malware in Runtime Code
articles.summary:

The package, indexed-btree, copied the identity of the legitimate sorted-btree library and recorded almost two million weekly downloads.
